rules.rationale: This guarded base equation defines digitResult(C,N) to preserve accumulator C when N is nonpositive; it is part of the mathematical digit-summary definition and does not model or replace program execution.

This guarded terminal equation defines the one-digit positive case of digitResult by adding the indicator for a final digit equal to 7; Stage 1 treats it as a derived definitional equation, not as a separately proved reusable lemma.

This fold-oriented recurrence defines digitResult for positive N by relating the accumulator after consuming N's last decimal digit and quotient to the named summary before that step; its direction controls simplification but it remains a mathematical definition.
This guarded base equation defines fizzResult(C,N) as C for nonpositive N, corresponding to the empty prefix of candidate integers; it is a summary equation with no operational configuration.
This qualifying-case recurrence defines fizzResult for positive N when N-1 is divisible by 11 or 13, folding the digitResult contribution of that candidate into the outer mathematical summary.
This complementary nonqualifying recurrence defines fizzResult for positive N when N-1 is divisible by neither 11 nor 13, preserving the accumulator while folding to the named outer summary.
